tender_metadata.tender_name: EPC Contract for Kankrej Pipeline Project From Existing Changa Main Pumping Station Dist: Banaskantha
tender_metadata.government: Government of Gujarat (Narmada, Water Resources, Water Supply and Kalpsar Department)
tender_metadata.class_of_registration: AA Class & Above (Gujarat State WRD / R&B)
tender_metadata.location: Banaskantha District, Gujarat (Kankrej Taluka - 20 Villages, 27 Ponds)
